items.title: Canada-Argentina at 7 pm in FIBA World Cup qualifier from Quebec City. A win by 7-0 Canada and an upset win by Panama over Bahamas in an 8 pm game tonight gets Canada in the 2027 World Cup. Canada has Lu Dort, Nickeil Walker-Alexander and Kelly Olynyk in lineup.
items.author: Doug Smith
items.body_excerpt:
Canada-Argentina at 7 pm in FIBA World Cup qualifier from Quebec City. A win by 7-0 Canada and an upset win by Panama over Bahamas in an 8 pm game tonight gets Canada in the 2027 World Cup. Canada has Lu Dort, Nickeil Walker-Alexander and Kelly Olynyk in lineup.
TSN has the broadcast.

items.title: Canada Basketball is 6-0 heading into next round of World Cup qualifying. Lu Dort Kelly Olynyk join for the games in Quebec City.  GM Rowan Barrett says 50 players committed overall, but actual availability shifts for each window. NAW the other NBA guy this time.
